Quiet Fresnaye Living

Set in a quiet, sought-after pocket of Fresnaye, this spacious 3rd floor apartment situated in this Art Deco apartment block offers the best of both worlds: a peaceful residential setting, not far away from the vibrant Sea Point lifestyle. Easy access to the Sea Point promenade, sidewalk cafes and outdoor living, while retreating to a calm well-managed building.

The home offers generous space, large living and dining room area flooded with natural light and views of Lions Head and the ocean.

The apartment has two well sized bedrooms with built in cupboards, a kitchen with space for three appliances, and 1 bathroom.

The enclosed balcony is a standout feature – the perfect spot to watch the afternoon sun go down over the ocean.

One parking bay.

Gated building and access-controlled gate.

The apartment is accessible by stairs only – no lift.

The property is currently tenanted. The tenant is leaving at the end of Jan 2027.

The last 2 photos in this listing are virtually staged to show what the apartment could look like. They are for illustrative purpose only and do not reflect the current condition.
